'''Muons''' were particles. [[Muon Gold]] was created by bombarding engine [[Lubricant/Legends|lubricant]] with muons.<ref name="Fly Casual">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref> In addition, Hyperspace jumps can be observed as a flash of a muon with the ship disappearing into it.<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy">''[[The Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>
